profile.name: Gam Ho
profile.tagline: Senior Talent Acquisition Executive | Global Hiring

paragraphs: I'm a Senior Talent Acquisition Executive at Gradion (formerly NFQ Asia), specializing in sourcing and securing top-tier professionals across tech and non-tech roles. I craft tailored recruitment strategies that attract the brightest minds in the industry.

With a hospitality management background, I bring a unique blend of professionalism and empathy to candidate engagement. My approach is data-driven and results-oriented, focusing on optimizing the recruitment lifecycle from initial outreach to successful onboarding.
I help shape Gradion as an employer of choice and a hub for innovation — aligning the right people with the right opportunities across Asia, DACH, and MENA regions.

experience.description: Leading strategic talent acquisition initiatives across tech and non-tech domains. Driving recruitment excellence as part of Gradion's continued evolution from NFQ Asia.

Continued recruitment operations during Gradion's rebrand from NFQ Asia. The company brings 23+ years of experience delivering technology solutions, now focused on scaling businesses through digital, deep tech & AI.

Managed the full recruitment lifecycle for IT and non-tech positions. Developed sourcing strategies, conducted market research, and delivered top talent to support company growth across Asia, DACH, and MENA regions.
Gained foundational experience in IT recruitment and HR operations, supporting the talent acquisition team in sourcing and screening candidates.
Delivered exceptional guest experiences at an international 5-star property. Built strong communication and interpersonal skills that later proved invaluable in recruitment and candidate engagement.
